source.text: וַֽעֲתַלְיָה֙ אֵ֣ם אֲחַזְיָ֔הוּ רָאֲתָ֖ה כִּ֣י מֵ֣ת בְּנָ֑הּ וַתָּ֨קָם֙ וַתְּאַבֵּ֔ד אֵ֖ת כָּל־זֶ֥רַע הַמַּמְלָכָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And Athaliah, mother of Ahaziah, saw that dead [was] her son, and arose and destroyed all [the] offspring of the kingdom.

en.L: And Athaliah, the mother of Ahaziah, saw that her son [was] dead, and she arose and destroyed all the offspring of the kingdom.
en.B: Athaliah, Ahaziah's mother, saw that her son was dead, and she set out to destroy the whole royal family.
en.R: Ahaziah's mother Athaliah saw that her son was dead. So she started killing everyone in the royal family.

es.L: Y Atalía, madre de Ocozías, vio que su hijo [estaba] muerto, y se levantó y exterminó a toda la descendencia real.
es.B: Atalía, la madre de Ocozías, vio que su hijo había muerto, y se puso a exterminar a toda la familia real.
es.R: Atalía, la madre de Ocozías, vio que su hijo había muerto. Entonces empezó a matar a todos los de la familia real.

fr.L: Et Athalie, mère d’Achazia, vit que son fils [était] mort, et elle se leva et fit périr toute la descendance royale.
fr.B: Athalie, mère d’Achazia, vit que son fils était mort, et elle entreprit de faire périr toute la famille royale.
fr.R: Athalie, la mère d’Achazia, a vu que son fils était mort. Alors elle a commencé à tuer tous les membres de la famille royale.

sw.L: Athalia, mama wa Ahazia, akaona kwamba mwanawe amekufa, akainuka, akaangamiza uzao wote wa kifalme.
sw.B: Athalia, mama wa Ahazia, alipoona kwamba mwanawe amekufa, aliinuka kuangamiza jamaa yote ya kifalme.
sw.R: Athalia mama wa Ahazia aliona kwamba mwanawe amekufa. Basi akaanza kuwaua watu wote wa jamaa ya kifalme.

vi.L: A-tha-li, mẹ của A-cha-xia, thấy con trai mình đã chết, thì đứng dậy tiêu diệt cả dòng dõi hoàng tộc.
vi.B: A-tha-li, mẹ của A-cha-xia, thấy con trai mình đã chết, liền ra tay tiêu diệt cả hoàng tộc.
vi.R: Bà A-tha-li, mẹ của A-cha-xia, thấy con trai mình đã chết. Vì vậy bà bắt đầu giết hết mọi người trong hoàng tộc.

ko.L: 그리고 아하시야의 어머니 아달랴가 자기 아들이 죽은 것을 보고, 일어나 왕국의 자손을 모두 멸했다.
ko.B: 아하시야의 어머니 아달랴는 자기 아들이 죽은 것을 보고, 왕족을 모두 없애려고 나섰다.
ko.R: 아하시야의 어머니 아달랴는 자기 아들이 죽은 것을 알았다. 그래서 그는 왕의 집안사람들을 모두 죽이기 시작했다.

pt.L: E Atalia, mãe de Acazias, viu que o seu filho [estava] morto, e se levantou e destruiu toda a descendência do reino.
pt.B: Atalia, mãe de Acazias, viu que o seu filho estava morto e começou a exterminar toda a família real.
pt.R: Atalia, a mãe de Acazias, viu que o seu filho estava morto. Então ela começou a matar todos da família real.

decisions.choice: Athaliah: the queen mother, of the house of Ahab
decisions.reason: Athaliah was a daughter of Ahab's house (8:18, 26) and the mother of Ahaziah king of Judah. Ahaziah had been killed by Jehu's men (9:27). With her son dead, she seized the throne herself.

decisions.choice: the offspring of the kingdom: the royal family, everyone with a claim to the throne
decisions.reason: The phrase means the king's descendants, the line from which the next king would come. Many of Ahaziah's relatives had already been killed by Jehu (10:13-14); Athaliah now kills the rest she can find.

decisions.choice: arose and destroyed: she set about killing them
decisions.reason: "Arose" marks the start of a deliberate action. The verse says what she set out to do; verse 2 shows that one child escaped.

decisions.choice: saw
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew and the traditional reading notes differ here by one letter (with or without "and" before "saw"). The sense is the same either way.

decisions.choice: 2 Chronicles 22:10-23:21 retells this story
decisions.reason: Chronicles tells the same events in nearly the same words, with some differences: it says that Jehosheba was Jehoiada's wife (2 Chronicles 22:11), and it gives a large part to the Levites and the assembly where Kings speaks of the Carites and the guards. The differences are noted at the verses where they occur.

decisions.choice: set out to destroy (Balanced); started killing (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable show that she began the killing but did not finish it (verse 2).

decisions.choice: "dòng dõi hoàng tộc" (L); "hoàng tộc" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Everyone of the royal family with a claim to the throne (m2).

decisions.choice: "왕국의 자손" (L), "왕족" (B), "왕의 집안사람들" (R) for "the offspring of the kingdom"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads it as the royal family, everyone with a claim to the throne (m2).

decisions.choice: Atalia; a descendência do reino (L), a família real (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "Atalia" is the queen's name (m1) as the shared list for Kings has it, stressed on the "i" and written without an accent. Literal keeps "a descendência do reino" (m2); Balanced and Readable say "a família real", as the English does, and show that she began the killing without finishing it (m3).

source.text: וַתִּקַּ֣ח יְהוֹשֶׁ֣בַע בַּת־הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־י֠וֹרָם אֲח֨וֹת אֲחַזְיָ֜הוּ אֶת־יוֹאָ֣שׁ בֶּן־אֲחַזְיָ֗ה וַתִּגְנֹ֤ב אֹתוֹ֙ מִתּ֤וֹךְ בְּנֵֽי־הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הַמּ֣וּמָתִ֔ים אֹת֥וֹ וְאֶת־מֵינִקְתּ֖וֹ בַּחֲדַ֣ר הַמִּטּ֑וֹת וַיַּסְתִּ֧רוּ אֹת֛וֹ מִפְּנֵ֥י עֲתַלְיָ֖הוּ וְלֹ֥א הוּמָֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: And took Jehosheba, daughter of the king Joram, sister of Ahaziah, Joash son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among [the] sons of the king who [were] being put to death, him and his nurse, in [the] room of the beds; and they hid him from before Athaliah, and not he was put to death.

en.L: And Jehosheba, the daughter of King Joram, the sister of Ahaziah, took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him away from among the sons of the king who were being put to death, [and put] him and his nurse in the room of the beds; and they hid him from Athaliah, and he was not put to death.
en.B: But Jehosheba, King Joram's daughter and Ahaziah's sister, took Ahaziah's son Joash and secretly took him out from among the king's sons who were about to be killed. She put him and his nurse in the bedroom, and they hid him from Athaliah, so he was not killed.
en.R: But Jehosheba, who was King Joram's daughter and Ahaziah's sister, took Ahaziah's son Joash. The king's sons were about to be killed, but she secretly took him away from among them. She put him and his nurse in a bedroom. So they kept him hidden from Athaliah, and he was not killed.

es.L: Pero Josaba, hija del rey Joram, hermana de Ocozías, tomó a Joás hijo de Ocozías y lo sacó a escondidas de entre los hijos del rey a quienes estaban matando, [y lo puso] a él y a su nodriza en el cuarto de las camas; y lo escondieron de Atalía, y no lo mataron.
es.B: Pero Josaba, hija del rey Joram y hermana de Ocozías, tomó a Joás, el hijo de Ocozías, y lo sacó a escondidas de entre los hijos del rey a quienes iban a matar. Lo puso con su nodriza en el dormitorio, y lo escondieron de Atalía, así que no lo mataron.
es.R: Pero Josaba, que era hija del rey Joram y hermana de Ocozías, tomó a Joás, el hijo de Ocozías. Iban a matar a los hijos del rey, pero ella lo sacó a escondidas de entre ellos. Lo puso con su nodriza en un dormitorio. Así lo mantuvieron escondido de Atalía, y no lo mataron.

fr.L: Et Yehosheba, fille du roi Joram, sœur d’Achazia, prit Joas fils d’Achazia et l’enleva du milieu des fils du roi qu’on faisait mourir, [et elle mit] lui et sa nourrice dans la chambre des lits ; et on le cacha devant Athalie, et il ne fut pas mis à mort.
fr.B: Mais Yehosheba, fille du roi Joram et sœur d’Achazia, prit Joas, fils d’Achazia, et l’enleva en secret du milieu des fils du roi qu’on allait tuer. Elle le mit avec sa nourrice dans la chambre à coucher, et on le cacha à Athalie, si bien qu’il ne fut pas tué.
fr.R: Mais Yehosheba, qui était la fille du roi Joram et la sœur d’Achazia, a pris Joas, le fils d’Achazia. On allait tuer les fils du roi, mais elle l’a emmené en secret du milieu d’eux. Elle l’a mis avec sa nourrice dans une chambre à coucher. Ainsi, ils l’ont caché à Athalie, et il n’a pas été tué.

sw.L: Lakini Yehosheba, binti mfalme Yoramu, dada yake Ahazia, akamchukua Yoashi mwana wa Ahazia, akamwiba kutoka katikati ya wana wa mfalme waliokuwa wakiuawa, [akamweka] yeye na mlezi wake katika chumba cha vitanda; wakamficha mbele ya Athalia, wala hakuuawa.
sw.B: Lakini Yehosheba, binti wa mfalme Yoramu na dada yake Ahazia, alimchukua Yoashi mwana wa Ahazia, akamtoa kwa siri katikati ya wana wa mfalme waliokuwa karibu kuuawa. Akamweka yeye na mlezi wake katika chumba cha kulala, nao wakamficha Athalia asimwone, kwa hiyo hakuuawa.
sw.R: Lakini Yehosheba, aliyekuwa binti wa mfalme Yoramu na dada yake Ahazia, alimchukua Yoashi mwana wa Ahazia. Wana wa mfalme walikuwa karibu kuuawa, lakini yeye akamtoa kwa siri katikati yao. Akamweka yeye na mlezi wake katika chumba cha kulala. Hivyo wakamficha Athalia asimwone, wala hakuuawa.

vi.L: Nhưng Giô-sê-ba, con gái vua Giô-ram, chị của A-cha-xia, đem Giô-ách con trai A-cha-xia, lén đem cậu ra khỏi giữa các con trai vua đang bị giết, [đặt] cậu cùng người vú nuôi trong phòng ngủ; và họ giấu cậu khỏi A-tha-li, nên cậu không bị giết.
vi.B: Nhưng Giô-sê-ba, con gái vua Giô-ram và là chị của A-cha-xia, bế Giô-ách con trai A-cha-xia, lén đưa cậu ra khỏi giữa các hoàng tử sắp bị giết. Bà để cậu cùng người vú nuôi trong phòng ngủ, và họ giấu cậu khỏi A-tha-li, nên cậu không bị giết.
vi.R: Nhưng Giô-sê-ba, con gái vua Giô-ram và là chị của A-cha-xia, đã bế Giô-ách con trai A-cha-xia đi. Các hoàng tử sắp bị giết, nhưng bà lén đưa cậu ra khỏi giữa họ. Bà để cậu cùng người vú nuôi trong một phòng ngủ. Vậy họ giấu cậu khỏi A-tha-li, và cậu không bị giết.

ko.L: 그러나 요람 왕의 딸이며 아하시야의 누이인 여호세바가 아하시야의 아들 요아스를 데려다가, 죽임을 당하고 있는 왕의 아들들 가운데서 몰래 빼내어, 그와 그의 유모를 침실에 [두었다]. 그리고 그들이 아달랴에게서 그를 숨겨서, 그가 죽임을 당하지 않았다.
ko.B: 그러나 요람 왕의 딸이며 아하시야의 누이인 여호세바가 아하시야의 아들 요아스를 데리고, 죽임을 당하게 된 왕자들 가운데서 몰래 빼내었다. 그는 요아스와 그의 유모를 침실에 숨겼다. 이렇게 그들이 아달랴에게서 요아스를 숨겨서, 요아스는 죽임을 당하지 않았다.
ko.R: 그러나 요람 왕의 딸이며 아하시야의 누이인 여호세바가 아하시야의 아들 요아스를 데려갔다. 왕자들이 막 죽임을 당하려 할 때에, 여호세바는 그들 가운데서 요아스를 몰래 빼내었다. 그리고 요아스와 그의 유모를 침실에 숨겼다. 이렇게 그들은 아달랴에게서 요아스를 숨겨 주었고, 요아스는 죽지 않았다.

pt.L: E Jeoseba, filha do rei Jorão, irmã de Acazias, tomou Joás, filho de Acazias, e o roubou do meio dos filhos do rei que estavam sendo mortos, [e pôs] a ele e à sua ama no quarto das camas; e o esconderam de Atalia, e ele não foi morto.
pt.B: Mas Jeoseba, filha do rei Jorão e irmã de Acazias, pegou Joás, filho de Acazias, e o tirou às escondidas do meio dos filhos do rei que iam ser mortos. Ela o pôs com a sua ama no quarto de dormir, e assim o esconderam de Atalia, e ele não foi morto.
pt.R: Mas Jeoseba, que era filha do rei Jorão e irmã de Acazias, pegou Joás, o filho de Acazias. Os filhos do rei estavam para ser mortos, mas ela tirou o menino do meio deles às escondidas. Ela o pôs com a sua ama num quarto de dormir. Assim as duas esconderam o menino de Atalia, e ele não foi morto.

decisions.choice: Jehosheba: the king's daughter and the dead king's sister
decisions.reason: Jehosheba was a daughter of King Joram of Judah and so the sister, or half-sister, of Ahaziah. The text does not say whether Athaliah was her mother. 2 Chronicles 22:11 adds that she was the wife of Jehoiada the priest, which explains how the child could be hidden in the temple (verse 3).

decisions.choice: the room of the beds: a bedroom
alternatives: a storeroom for beds and bedding
decisions.reason: The phrase means a room for beds. It may be a bedroom in the palace or the temple buildings, or a storeroom where beds and bedding were kept. Either way it was a place where a small child and his nurse could be kept out of sight.

decisions.choice: him and his nurse: the verb for putting them in the room is understood
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names Joash and his nurse and the room but gives no verb for putting them there. 2 Chronicles 22:11, which tells the same event, has "and she put him and his nurse in the room of the beds".

decisions.choice: they hid him: Jehosheba and the nurse
decisions.reason: The verb is plural. It most likely means Jehosheba and the nurse together; 2 Chronicles 22:11 has "she hid him".

decisions.choice: who were being put to death: the killing was under way
decisions.reason: The form describes the king's sons as in the process of being killed. Jehosheba took the child out from among them before he could be found.

decisions.choice: [and put]
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the missing verb in brackets (m3).

decisions.choice: the bedroom (Balanced); a bedroom (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the everyday word for a room for beds; the footnote on m2 gives the other possible sense.

decisions.choice: "Yehosheba"; "Joas"
decisions.reason: The princess’s name is transcribed as the other names of these books; the king is "Joas" where the Hebrew has the short form, as the Kings terms note.

decisions.choice: "chị của A-cha-xia"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese must say whether a sister is older or younger; the Hebrew does not say, and "chị" is chosen because she acts as a grown woman with charge of the child (uncertain).

decisions.choice: "여호세바" for Jehosheba, "요아스" for Joash and "누이" for "sister"
decisions.reason: The usual Protestant forms. Korean must choose older or younger sister; the Hebrew does not say, and "누이" leaves it open.

decisions.choice: Jeoseba; Joás; a sua ama
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "Jeoseba" (m1) writes the princess's name as Brazilian Portuguese writes "Jeo-" names, and "Joás" is the king's name as the shared list for Kings has it. The nurse is "ama", the Portuguese word for a woman who nurses and cares for another's child. Readable says "as duas", since the plural "they" means Jehosheba and the nurse (m4).

source.text: וַיְהִ֤י אִתָּהּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה מִתְחַבֵּ֖א שֵׁ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֑ים וַעֲתַלְיָ֖ה מֹלֶ֥כֶת עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And he was with her [in the] house of Yahweh hiding himself six years, and Athaliah [was] reigning over the land.

en.L: And he was with her [in] the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, hiding, six years, while Athaliah was reigning over the land.
en.B: He stayed hidden with her in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} six years, during Athaliah's rule over the land.
en.R: For six years Joash stayed hidden with Jehosheba in the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, while Athaliah ruled the country as queen.

es.L: Y estuvo con ella escondido en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} seis años, mientras Atalía reinaba sobre el país.
es.B: Estuvo escondido con ella en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} durante seis años, mientras Atalía gobernaba el país.
es.R: Durante seis años Joás estuvo escondido con Josaba en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, mientras Atalía gobernaba el país como reina.

fr.L: Et il fut avec elle [dans] la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, caché, six ans, tandis qu’Athalie régnait sur le pays.
fr.B: Il resta caché avec elle dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pendant six ans, tandis qu’Athalie régnait sur le pays.
fr.R: Pendant six ans, Joas est resté caché avec Yehosheba dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, pendant qu’Athalie gouvernait le pays comme reine.

sw.L: Naye akawa pamoja naye [katika] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, amejificha, miaka sita, Athalia alipokuwa akitawala juu ya nchi.
sw.B: Alikaa amefichwa pamoja naye katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} miaka sita, wakati Athalia alipotawala juu ya nchi.
sw.R: Kwa miaka sita Yoashi alikaa amefichwa pamoja na Yehosheba katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakati Athalia alipotawala nchi kama malkia.

vi.L: Cậu ở với bà trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, ẩn mình sáu năm, trong khi A-tha-li cai trị xứ.
vi.B: Cậu ở ẩn với bà trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sáu năm, trong thời gian A-tha-li cai trị xứ.
vi.R: Suốt sáu năm, Giô-ách ở ẩn với Giô-sê-ba trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, trong khi A-tha-li làm nữ hoàng cai trị xứ.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그와 함께 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 숨어서 6년을 지냈고, 아달랴가 그 땅을 다스리고 있었다.
ko.B: 요아스는 여호세바와 함께 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 숨어서 6년을 지냈다. 그동안 아달랴가 그 땅을 다스렸다.
ko.R: 요아스는 여호세바와 함께 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 숨어서 6년 동안 지냈다. 그동안 아달랴가 여왕이 되어 나라를 다스렸다.

pt.L: E ele esteve com ela [na] casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, escondido, seis anos, enquanto Atalia reinava sobre a terra.
pt.B: Ele ficou escondido com ela na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} durante seis anos, enquanto Atalia governava o país.
pt.R: Durante seis anos Joás ficou escondido com Jeoseba no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, enquanto Atalia governava o país como rainha.

decisions.choice: with her: with Jehosheba
decisions.reason: "Her" most naturally means Jehosheba, who rescued him (verse 2); it could also mean the nurse, who was hidden with him.

decisions.choice: the house of Yahweh: the temple in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The child was hidden in the temple buildings, where Jehoiada the priest served (verse 4). The temple had many side rooms (1 Kings 6:5).

decisions.choice: Athaliah was reigning: the only woman to rule as monarch in Judah or Israel
decisions.reason: Athaliah held the throne for six years. Unlike every king of Judah and Israel, her reign has no opening or closing formula in Kings, and no one is said to reign after her until Joash.

decisions.choice: Joash; Jehosheba; as queen
decisions.reason: Readable names the people the pronouns refer to (m1) and says that Athaliah ruled as queen.

decisions.choice: la casa del SEÑOR (Literal, Balanced); el templo del SEÑOR (Readable)
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for the house of the LORD at each level, through Kings and Chronicles.

decisions.choice: "la maison du SEIGNEUR" (L, B); "le temple du SEIGNEUR" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Kings terms note, for the whole block.

decisions.choice: "nyumba ya BWANA" (Literal, Balanced); "hekalu la BWANA" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The house of the LORD follows the terms note for Kings at each level.

decisions.choice: "nhà của CHÚA" (L, B); "đền thờ của CHÚA" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for the house of the LORD, kept at each level through Kings.

records.literal_gloss: And in the year the seventh sent Jehoiada and took the commanders of the hundreds of the Carites and of the runners, and brought them to him [to the] house of Yahweh; and cut to them a covenant and made swear them in [the] house of Yahweh, and showed them the son of the king.

en.L: And in the seventh year Jehoiada sent and took the commanders of hundreds of the Carites and of the runners, and he brought them to himself [into] the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; and he made a covenant with them and made them swear in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and he showed them the son of the king.
en.B: In the seventh year Jehoiada sent for the commanders of hundreds of the Carites and of the guards and had them brought to him in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He made a covenant with them and put them under oath in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Then he showed them the king's son.
en.R: In the seventh year Jehoiada the priest sent for the commanders of the Carites and of the palace guards, each of whom led a hundred men. He had them come to him in the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. There he made a covenant with them and had them swear an oath. Then he showed them the king's son.

es.L: Y en el año séptimo Joiada envió y tomó a los jefes de cien de los carios y de la guardia, y los hizo venir a él a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; e hizo un pacto con ellos y los hizo jurar en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y les mostró al hijo del rey.
es.B: En el séptimo año, Joiada mandó llamar a los jefes de cien de los carios y de la guardia, y los hizo venir ante él a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Hizo un pacto con ellos y les tomó juramento en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Luego les mostró al hijo del rey.
es.R: En el séptimo año, el sacerdote Joiada mandó llamar a los jefes de los carios y de la guardia del palacio, cada uno de los cuales mandaba cien hombres. Hizo que vinieran a verlo al templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Allí hizo un pacto con ellos y les hizo hacer un juramento. Luego les mostró al hijo del rey.

fr.L: Et la septième année, Yehoyada envoya prendre les chefs de centaines des Cariens et des coureurs, et il les fit venir auprès de lui [dans] la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; et il conclut avec eux une alliance et les fit jurer dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et il leur montra le fils du roi.
fr.B: La septième année, Yehoyada envoya chercher les chefs de centaines des Cariens et des gardes, et il les fit venir auprès de lui dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Il conclut avec eux une alliance et leur fit prêter serment dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Puis il leur montra le fils du roi.
fr.R: La septième année, Yehoyada le prêtre a fait venir les chefs des Cariens et des gardes du palais, qui commandaient chacun cent hommes. Il les a fait venir auprès de lui dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Là, il a conclu une alliance avec eux et il leur a fait prêter serment. Ensuite il leur a montré le fils du roi.

sw.B: Katika mwaka wa saba Yehoyada aliwaita wakuu wa mamia wa Wakari na wa walinzi, akawaleta kwake katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Akafanya agano nao, akawaapisha katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kisha akawaonyesha mwana wa mfalme.
sw.R: Katika mwaka wa saba Yehoyada kuhani aliwaita makamanda wa Wakari na wa walinzi wa ikulu, kila mmoja wao akiongoza watu mia moja. Akawafanya waje kwake katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Huko akafanya agano nao, akawaapisha. Kisha akawaonyesha mwana wa mfalme.

vi.L: Năm thứ bảy, Giê-hô-gia-đa sai người đi gọi các chỉ huy trăm người của người Ca-rít và của các vệ binh, đem họ đến với mình trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; ông lập giao ước với họ, bắt họ thề trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, rồi cho họ xem con trai của vua.
vi.B: Năm thứ bảy, Giê-hô-gia-đa cho mời các chỉ huy trăm người của quân Ca-rít và của đội vệ binh đến gặp mình trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Ông lập giao ước với họ và bắt họ thề trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Rồi ông cho họ xem hoàng tử.
vi.R: Năm thứ bảy, thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa cho mời các chỉ huy của quân Ca-rít và của đội vệ binh hoàng cung, mỗi người chỉ huy một trăm quân. Ông bảo họ đến gặp mình trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Tại đó ông lập giao ước với họ và bắt họ thề. Rồi ông cho họ xem hoàng tử.

ko.L: 그리고 일곱째 해에 여호야다가 사람을 보내어 가리 사람들과 달리는 자들의 백부장들을 데려다가, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집으로 자기에게 오게 했다. 그리고 그가 그들과 언약을 맺고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 그들에게 맹세하게 한 다음, 그들에게 왕의 아들을 보여 주었다.
ko.B: 일곱째 해에 여호야다가 사람을 보내어 가리 사람들과 호위병들의 백부장들을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집으로 불러들였다. 그는 그들과 언약을 맺고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 그들에게 맹세하게 했다. 그런 다음 그들에게 왕자를 보여 주었다.
ko.R: 일곱째 해에 제사장 여호야다는 가리 사람들과 왕궁 호위병들의 지휘관들을 불렀다. 그들은 저마다 군인 백 명씩을 거느리고 있었다. 여호야다는 그들을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전으로 오게 했다. 그리고 그곳에서 그들과 언약을 맺고 맹세하게 했다. 그런 다음 그들에게 왕자를 보여 주었다.

pt.L: E no sétimo ano Joiada enviou e tomou os chefes de centenas dos cários e dos corredores, e os trouxe a si [na] casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}; e fez com eles uma aliança e os fez jurar na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e lhes mostrou o filho do rei.
pt.B: No sétimo ano, Joiada mandou chamar os comandantes de centenas dos cários e da guarda e os fez vir até ele na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Fez uma aliança com eles e os fez jurar na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Depois lhes mostrou o filho do rei.
pt.R: No sétimo ano, Joiada, o sacerdote, mandou chamar os comandantes dos cários e dos guardas do palácio, cada um deles chefe de cem homens. Ele os fez vir até ele no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Ali fez uma aliança com eles e os fez jurar. Depois lhes mostrou o filho do rei.

decisions.choice: Jehoiada: the priest at the temple
decisions.reason: Jehoiada is called "the priest" from verse 9 on. 2 Chronicles 22:11 says he was Jehosheba's husband (verse 2).

decisions.choice: the Carites: a unit of the royal guard, perhaps foreign soldiers
decisions.reason: The name appears only here, in verse 19 and in the written text of 2 Samuel 20:23. It may refer to soldiers hired from Caria, a land in the southwest of Asia Minor whose men served as soldiers abroad, or it may be another form of the name "Cherethites", David's foreign guard (2 Samuel 8:18; 1 Kings 1:38). Either way they were part of the king's guard. 2 Chronicles 23:1-2 does not name them and speaks instead of the Levites and the heads of families.

decisions.choice: the runners: the king's guard
decisions.reason: The "runners" were royal guards who ran before the king's chariot and kept watch at his palace (1 Kings 14:27-28).

decisions.choice: commanders of hundreds: officers each over a unit of about a hundred men
decisions.reason: The army and the guard were organized in units of thousands, hundreds, fifties and tens (1 Samuel 22:7; Exodus 18:21).

decisions.choice: made a covenant with them and made them swear: a sworn agreement
decisions.reason: Jehoiada bound the officers to himself by an oath taken in the temple, before Yahweh, before he risked showing them the hidden prince.

decisions.choice: the guards (Balanced); the palace guards (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 14:27, Balanced and Readable name what the runners were (m3).

decisions.choice: the priest; each of whom led a hundred men
decisions.reason: Readable says who Jehoiada was (verse 9) and explains "commanders of hundreds".

decisions.choice: la guardia (Literal, Balanced); la guardia del palacio (Readable)
decisions.reason: As at 10:25, the "runners" are the royal guard (m3); Spanish "corredores" would not be read that way, so every level names the guard.

decisions.choice: "les Cariens"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name of this guard unit is transcribed in its usual French form; the meaning decision notes they were perhaps foreign soldiers.

decisions.choice: "wakimbiaji" (Literal); "walinzi" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The king's "runners" are his guard; Literal keeps the word, and Balanced and Readable say what they were, as English does.

decisions.choice: "người Ca-rít" (L); "quân Ca-rít" (B, R); "các vệ binh"
decisions.reason: The Carites are a unit of the royal guard, perhaps foreign (m2), named as a people; the "runners" are the guards, as at 10:25.

decisions.choice: "백부장" (L, B) for the commanders of hundreds, "가리 사람들" for the Carites, "달리는 자들" (L) and "호위병들" (B, R) for the runners
decisions.reason: "백부장" is the established Korean title; the runners follow 10:25; "여호야다" as the 2 Samuel drafts.

decisions.choice: Joiada, o sacerdote; os cários; os corredores (L), a guarda (B), os guardas do palácio (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "Joiada" (m1) is the form 2 Samuel 8:18 gives the father of Benaiah, the same Hebrew name; he is "Joiada, o sacerdote" in the Hebrew order at Literal and "o sacerdote Joiada" at Balanced and Readable, as 1 Kings 1:8 places Zadok's title. The Carites (m2) are "os cários", the Portuguese name of the men of Caria, kept apart from "os queretitas" of 2 Samuel, as the English keeps them apart; the runners (m3) are "corredores" at Literal and "a guarda" at Balanced, as 1 Kings 14:27 sets them.

decisions.choice: os chefes de centenas (L), os comandantes de centenas (B), os comandantes ... chefe de cem homens (R); uma aliança
decisions.reason: The officers over a hundred (m4) take the words 1:9 sets for the book for the officer over fifty: "chefe" at Literal, as Exodus 18:21 has it in Portuguese, and "comandante" at Balanced and Readable. The sworn agreement (m5) is "aliança", the Old Testament terms' word for a covenant.

en.L: And he commanded them, saying, "This [is] the thing that you shall do: the third of you who come in on the sabbath [shall be] keepers of the watch of the house of the king,
en.B: He gave them this order: "Here is what you must do. One third of you, the men who come on duty on the sabbath, will keep watch over the king's palace,

fr.B: Il leur donna cet ordre : « Voici ce que vous devez faire. Un tiers d’entre vous, ceux qui prennent leur service le jour du sabbat, montera la garde au palais du roi,

sw.B: Akawapa amri hii: "Hivi ndivyo mtakavyofanya. Theluthi moja yenu, wale wanaoingia zamu siku ya Sabato, watalinda ikulu ya mfalme,
sw.R: Akawapa maagizo haya: "Hivi ndivyo mtakavyofanya. Watu wanaoanza zamu siku ya Sabato watagawanywa katika vikundi vitatu. Kikundi kimoja kitalinda ikulu ya mfalme.

vi.L: Ông truyền cho họ: "Đây là điều các anh phải làm: một phần ba trong các anh, những người vào phiên ngày Sa-bát, sẽ canh giữ cung vua,
vi.B: Ông ra lệnh cho họ: "Đây là điều các anh phải làm: một phần ba trong số các anh, là những người vào phiên ngày Sa-bát, sẽ canh giữ cung vua,
vi.R: Ông ra lệnh cho họ: "Đây là điều các anh phải làm. Những người vào phiên trực ngày Sa-bát sẽ chia làm ba nhóm. Một nhóm canh giữ cung vua.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그들에게 명령하여 말했다. "당신들이 할 일은 이것이오. 당신들 가운데 안식일에 들어오는 삼분의 일은 왕궁의 경비를 서고,
ko.B: 그는 그들에게 이렇게 명령했다. "당신들이 할 일은 이렇소. 안식일에 근무하러 들어오는 사람들 가운데 삼분의 일은 왕궁을 지키고,
ko.R: 그는 그들에게 이렇게 명령했다. "당신들이 할 일은 이렇소. 안식일에 근무를 시작하는 사람들을 세 무리로 나누시오. 한 무리는 왕궁을 지키시오.

pt.L: E ele lhes ordenou, dizendo: "Esta [é] a coisa que vocês farão: a terça parte de vocês, os que entram no sábado, [serão] guardas da vigilância da casa do rei,
pt.B: Ele lhes deu esta ordem: "Vocês vão fazer o seguinte: um terço de vocês, os homens que entram de serviço no sábado, vai vigiar o palácio do rei,
pt.R: Ele lhes deu estas ordens: "Vocês vão fazer o seguinte. Os homens que começam o serviço no sábado vão ser divididos em três grupos. Um grupo vai guardar o palácio do rei.

decisions.choice: coming in on the sabbath: coming on duty when the guard changed
alternatives: those who came to the temple on the sabbath
decisions.reason: The guard served in shifts that changed on the sabbath. Those "coming in" began their duty that day; those "going out" (verses 7 and 9) ended theirs. On that day both groups were in the city at once, which gave Jehoiada a double force without raising suspicion.

decisions.choice: the third of you: the men coming on duty are divided into three groups
alternatives: a third of you who come on duty, and those who keep watch over the palace
decisions.reason: Verses 5-7 are hard to follow in Hebrew. The most likely reading is that the men coming on duty are split into three parts, one at the palace and one at each of two gates (verse 6), while the two companies going off duty guard the temple and the king (verse 7). The "and" before "keepers" may instead join two groups, so that the verse describes more units than three.

decisions.choice: the house of the king: the palace
decisions.reason: The palace stood beside the temple, close enough that Athaliah could hear the noise (verse 13).

decisions.choice: will be divided into three groups. One group
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the division into three that verses 5-6 imply (m2).

decisions.choice: el sábado
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch note's "el sábado"; Readable keeps it here, since the English Readable does not explain the word and the change of guard is the point.

decisions.choice: Jehoiada calls the commanders "các anh"
decisions.reason: The priest gives orders to men who have sworn a covenant with him; he speaks firmly but as a fellow servant of the coming king.

decisions.choice: Jehoiada gives the commanders his orders in 하오체
decisions.reason: The priest commands officers who have sworn to him; 하오체 is a firm order that still respects their rank.

decisions.choice: Literal and Balanced leave verse 5 open ("서고,", "지키고,") into verse 6, as the English does; Readable closes it
decisions.reason: The Korean connective carries the list over the verse break.

decisions.choice: os que entram no sábado (L); os que entram de serviço no sábado (B); os que começam o serviço no sábado (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "entrar" and "sair" for the change of guard (m1); Balanced and Readable say "entrar de serviço", "deixar o serviço", the Portuguese for going on and off duty. "Sábado" lowercase, as the style guide sets. Jehoiada speaks to the officers with "vocês".

source.text: וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית֙ בְּשַׁ֣עַר ס֔וּר וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁ֥ית בַּשַּׁ֖עַר אַחַ֣ר הָרָצִ֑ים וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֛ם אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַבַּ֖יִת מַסָּֽח׃

records.literal_gloss: and the third at [the] gate of Sur, and the third at the gate behind the runners; and you will keep [the] watch of the house, by turns.

en.L: and the third at the gate of Sur, and the third at the gate behind the runners; and you shall keep the watch of the house by turns.
en.B: one third at the Sur Gate, and one third at the gate behind the guards. So you will guard the palace in turns.
en.R: Another group will be at the Sur Gate, and the third group at the gate behind the guards. In this way you will take turns guarding the palace.

es.L: y la tercera parte en la puerta de Sur, y la tercera parte en la puerta detrás de la guardia; y {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} la guardia de la casa por turnos.
es.B: otra tercera parte en la puerta de Sur, y otra tercera parte en la puerta que está detrás de la guardia. Así {{plural_you:vigilarán|vigilaréis}} el palacio por turnos.
es.R: Otro grupo estará en la puerta de Sur, y el tercer grupo en la puerta que está detrás de la guardia. Así {{plural_you:se turnarán|os turnaréis}} para vigilar el palacio.

fr.L: et le tiers à la porte de Sour, et le tiers à la porte derrière les coureurs ; et vous monterez la garde de la maison, à tour de rôle.
fr.B: un tiers à la porte de Sour, et un tiers à la porte derrière les gardes. Ainsi vous garderez le palais à tour de rôle.
fr.R: Un autre groupe sera à la porte de Sour, et le troisième groupe à la porte derrière les gardes. De cette manière, vous garderez le palais chacun à votre tour.

sw.L: na theluthi moja kwenye lango la Suri, na theluthi moja kwenye lango lililo nyuma ya wakimbiaji; nanyi mtalinda zamu ya nyumba kwa zamu.
sw.B: theluthi moja kwenye Lango la Suri, na theluthi moja kwenye lango lililo nyuma ya walinzi. Hivyo mtailinda ikulu kwa zamu.
sw.R: Kikundi kingine kitakuwa kwenye Lango la Suri, na kikundi cha tatu kwenye lango lililo nyuma ya walinzi. Kwa njia hii mtapokezana kuilinda ikulu.

vi.L: một phần ba ở cổng Su-rơ, và một phần ba ở cổng phía sau các vệ binh; các anh sẽ thay phiên canh giữ cung điện.
vi.B: một phần ba ở cổng Su-rơ, và một phần ba ở cổng phía sau đội vệ binh. Như vậy các anh sẽ thay phiên nhau canh giữ cung điện.
vi.R: Một nhóm khác ở cổng Su-rơ, và nhóm thứ ba ở cổng phía sau đội vệ binh. Như vậy các anh sẽ thay phiên nhau canh giữ cung điện.

ko.L: 삼분의 일은 수르 문에, 삼분의 일은 달리는 자들 뒤에 있는 문에 [있으시오]. 그렇게 당신들은 번갈아 그 집의 경비를 서시오.
ko.B: 삼분의 일은 수르 문을, 삼분의 일은 호위병들 뒤에 있는 문을 지키시오. 이렇게 당신들은 번갈아 왕궁을 지키시오.
ko.R: 또 한 무리는 수르 문을 지키고, 셋째 무리는 호위병들 뒤에 있는 문을 지키시오. 이렇게 당신들은 번갈아 가며 왕궁을 지키시오.

pt.L: e a terça parte [estará] na porta de Sur, e a terça parte na porta atrás dos corredores; e vocês guardarão a vigilância da casa, alternadamente.
pt.B: um terço na porta de Sur e um terço na porta que fica atrás da guarda. Assim vocês vão vigiar o palácio em turnos.
pt.R: Outro grupo vai ficar na porta de Sur, e o terceiro grupo na porta que fica atrás dos guardas. Assim vocês vão se revezar na guarda do palácio.

decisions.choice: the gate of Sur: a gate of the palace or temple whose site is unknown
decisions.reason: This gate is not named anywhere else. 2 Chronicles 23:5 has "the gate of the Foundation" instead, which in Hebrew differs from "Sur" by little more than one letter.

decisions.choice: the gate behind the runners: probably the guards' gate into the palace
decisions.reason: Verse 19 speaks of "the gate of the runners" leading from the temple to the palace; this is probably the same gate, near the guards' quarters.

decisions.choice: by turns: in shifts
decisions.reason: The last word of the verse appears nowhere else, and its sense is a guess from context. It may mean "in turns", "as a barrier" (keeping people away), or it may be a place name.

decisions.choice: the house: the palace
decisions.reason: After verse 5, "the house" here most likely means the king's house, the palace, rather than the temple, which is named separately in verse 7.

source.text: וּשְׁתֵּ֤י הַיָּדוֹת֙ בָּכֶ֔ם כֹּ֖ל יֹצְאֵ֣י הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת וְשָֽׁמְר֛וּ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת בֵּית־יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] two of the hands among you, all [those] going out [on] the sabbath, and they will keep [the] watch of [the] house of Yahweh for the king.

en.L: And the two divisions among you, all who go out on the sabbath, shall keep the watch of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for the king.
en.B: The two companies of you who go off duty on the sabbath are all to keep watch over the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to protect the king.
en.R: Your other two groups, the men who finish their duty on the sabbath, must all guard the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to protect the king.

es.L: Y las dos secciones de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, todos los que salen el sábado, harán la guardia de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} junto al rey.
es.B: Las dos compañías de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} que salen de servicio el sábado vigilarán todas la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} para proteger al rey.
es.R: {{plural_you:Sus|Vuestros}} otros dos grupos, los que terminan su servicio el sábado, vigilarán el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} para proteger al rey.

fr.L: Et les deux sections d’entre vous, tous ceux qui sortent le jour du sabbat, monteront la garde de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} auprès du roi.
fr.B: Les deux groupes d’entre vous qui quittent leur service le jour du sabbat monteront tous la garde à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pour protéger le roi.
fr.R: Vos deux autres groupes, les hommes qui finissent leur service le jour du sabbat, garderont tous le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pour protéger le roi.

sw.L: Na vikosi viwili kati yenu, wote wanaotoka siku ya Sabato, watalinda zamu ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa ajili ya mfalme.
sw.B: Vikosi viwili vyenu vinavyotoka zamu siku ya Sabato vyote vitalinda nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ili kumlinda mfalme.
sw.R: Vikundi vyenu vingine viwili, watu wanaomaliza zamu yao siku ya Sabato, wote lazima walinde hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ili kumlinda mfalme.

vi.L: Còn hai đội trong các anh, tất cả những người ra phiên ngày Sa-bát, sẽ canh giữ nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho vua.
vi.B: Hai đội của các anh mãn phiên ngày Sa-bát thì tất cả phải canh giữ nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để bảo vệ vua.
vi.R: Hai nhóm còn lại của các anh, là những người hết phiên trực ngày Sa-bát, phải canh giữ đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để bảo vệ vua.

ko.L: 그리고 당신들 가운데 안식일에 나가는 두 부대는 모두 왕을 위하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집의 경비를 서시오.
ko.B: 그리고 안식일에 근무를 마치고 나가는 두 부대는 모두 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 지키며 왕을 보호하시오.
ko.R: 안식일에 근무를 마치는 나머지 두 무리는 모두 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전을 지키며 왕을 보호하시오.

pt.L: E as duas divisões dentre vocês, todos os que saem no sábado, guardarão a vigilância da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} para o rei.
pt.B: As duas companhias de vocês que deixam o serviço no sábado vão todas vigiar a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} para proteger o rei.
pt.R: Os outros dois grupos de vocês, os homens que terminam o serviço no sábado, devem todos guardar o templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} para proteger o rei.

decisions.choice: the two hands: two divisions or companies
decisions.reason: "Hand" here means a part or share (Genesis 47:24). The guard was made up of companies, and two of them were going off duty.

decisions.choice: going out on the sabbath: going off duty
decisions.reason: As in verse 5. Those going off duty did not go home but were kept at the temple.

decisions.choice: for the king: to protect the king
decisions.reason: Their task in the temple was to guard the young king when he was brought out (verse 8).

decisions.choice: Your other two groups
decisions.reason: Readable adds "other" to show that these are different from the three groups of verses 5-6, following the reading in the decision at verse 5.

decisions.choice: "두 부대" at Literal for "the two hands"
decisions.reason: A word-for-word "two hands" would not be understood; the meaning decision reads it as two divisions (m1).

source.text: וְהִקַּפְתֶּ֨ם עַל־הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ סָבִ֗יב אִ֚ישׁ וְכֵלָ֣יו בְּיָד֔וֹ וְהַבָּ֥א אֶל־הַשְּׂדֵר֖וֹת יוּמָ֑ת וִהְי֥וּ אֶת־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּצֵאת֥וֹ וּבְבֹאֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will surround the king all around, each man and his weapons in his hand, and the [one] coming into the ranks will be put to death; and be with the king in his going out and in his coming in.

en.L: And you shall surround the king all around, each man with his weapons in his hand, and whoever comes into the ranks shall be put to death; and be with the king when he goes out and when he comes in."
en.B: Surround the king on every side, each man with his weapons in hand. Anyone who comes within your ranks must be put to death. Stay with the king wherever he goes."
en.R: Form a circle around the king, every man holding his weapons. Anyone who comes inside your lines must be killed. Stay close to the king wherever he goes."

es.L: Y {{plural_you:rodearán|rodearéis}} al rey por todos lados, cada uno con sus armas en la mano, y el que entre en las filas será muerto; y {{plural_you:estén|estad}} con el rey cuando salga y cuando entre».
es.B: {{plural_you:Rodeen|Rodead}} al rey por todos lados, cada uno con sus armas en la mano. Cualquiera que se meta entre {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} filas debe morir. {{plural_you:Acompañen|Acompañad}} al rey adondequiera que vaya».
es.R: {{plural_you:Formen|Formad}} un círculo alrededor del rey, cada uno con sus armas en la mano. Si alguien se mete entre {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} filas, {{plural_you:mátenlo|matadlo}}. {{plural_you:Quédense|Quedaos}} junto al rey adondequiera que vaya».

fr.L: Et vous entourerez le roi de tous côtés, chacun ses armes à la main, et quiconque entrera dans les rangs sera mis à mort ; et soyez avec le roi quand il sortira et quand il entrera. »
fr.B: Entourez le roi de tous côtés, chacun les armes à la main. Quiconque pénétrera dans vos rangs devra être mis à mort. Restez avec le roi partout où il ira. »
fr.R: Formez un cercle autour du roi, chacun tenant ses armes. Si quelqu’un entre dans vos rangs, tuez-le. Restez près du roi partout où il ira. »

sw.L: Nanyi mtamzunguka mfalme pande zote, kila mtu na silaha zake mkononi mwake, na yeyote atakayeingia katika safu atauawa; nanyi mkae pamoja na mfalme atokapo na aingiapo."
sw.B: Mzungukeni mfalme pande zote, kila mtu akiwa na silaha zake mkononi. Yeyote atakayeingia katika safu zenu lazima auawe. Kaeni pamoja na mfalme popote aendapo."
sw.R: Mzungukeni mfalme, kila mtu akiwa ameshika silaha zake. Mtu yeyote atakayeingia ndani ya safu zenu lazima auawe. Kaeni karibu na mfalme popote aendapo."

vi.L: Các anh sẽ vây quanh vua, mỗi người cầm vũ khí trong tay, và ai xông vào hàng ngũ sẽ bị giết; hãy ở với vua khi vua ra và khi vua vào."
vi.B: Hãy vây quanh vua tứ phía, mỗi người cầm vũ khí trong tay. Ai xông vào hàng ngũ phải bị giết. Hãy ở bên vua bất cứ vua đi đâu."
vi.R: Hãy đứng thành vòng quanh vua, mỗi người cầm sẵn vũ khí. Ai xông vào bên trong hàng ngũ phải bị giết. Hãy ở sát bên vua bất cứ vua đi đâu."

ko.L: 그리고 당신들은 각자 손에 무기를 들고 왕을 사방으로 둘러싸시오. 대열 안으로 들어오는 자는 죽여야 하오. 왕이 나가실 때에도 들어오실 때에도 왕과 함께 있으시오."
ko.B: 각자 손에 무기를 들고 왕을 사방으로 둘러싸시오. 대열 안으로 들어오는 사람은 누구든지 죽여야 하오. 왕께서 어디로 가시든지 왕 곁에 있으시오."
ko.R: 모두 무기를 들고 왕을 빙 둘러싸시오. 당신들의 줄 안으로 들어오는 사람은 누구든지 죽이시오. 왕께서 어디로 가시든지 왕 곁을 떠나지 마시오."

pt.L: E vocês cercarão o rei ao redor, cada homem com as suas armas na mão, e quem entrar nas fileiras será morto; e estejam com o rei quando ele sair e quando ele entrar."
pt.B: Cerquem o rei por todos os lados, cada um com as suas armas na mão. Quem entrar nas suas fileiras deve ser morto. Fiquem com o rei aonde quer que ele vá."
pt.R: Façam um círculo em volta do rei, cada um segurando as suas armas. Quem entrar nas suas linhas deve ser morto. Fiquem perto do rei aonde quer que ele vá."

decisions.choice: the ranks: the lines of guards
decisions.reason: The word means rows or ranks. Here it most likely means the lines the guards formed around the king, so that anyone pushing into them was an attacker. It is used again in verse 15.

decisions.choice: when he goes out and when he comes in: wherever he goes
decisions.reason: Going out and coming in together cover all of a person's movements (Deuteronomy 28:6; 1 Samuel 18:16).

decisions.choice: the orders end here
decisions.reason: Jehoiada's orders that began in verse 5 end with this verse; verse 9 tells how they were carried out.

decisions.choice: wherever he goes
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the idiom (m2).

source.text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֞וּ שָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּא֗וֹת כְּכֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה֮ יְהוֹיָדָ֣ע הַכֹּהֵן֒ וַיִּקְחוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־אֲנָשָׁ֔יו בָּאֵ֣י הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת עִ֖ם יֹצְאֵ֣י הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל־יְהוֹיָדָ֥ע הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And did [the] commanders of the hundreds according to all that commanded Jehoiada the priest, and took each his men, [those] coming in [on] the sabbath with [those] going out [on] the sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.

en.L: And the commanders of hundreds did according to all that Jehoiada the priest had commanded, and each took his men, those coming in on the sabbath with those going out on the sabbath, and they came to Jehoiada the priest.
en.B: The commanders of hundreds did everything Jehoiada the priest had ordered. Each brought his men, both the ones who came on duty on the sabbath and the ones who went off duty that day, and they came to Jehoiada the priest.
en.R: The commanders did just what Jehoiada the priest told them. Each one brought his men, both those who were starting their duty on the sabbath and those who were finishing it. They all came to Jehoiada the priest.

es.L: E hicieron los jefes de cien conforme a todo lo que había mandado el sacerdote Joiada, y tomó cada uno a sus hombres, los que entraban el sábado con los que salían el sábado, y vinieron al sacerdote Joiada.
es.B: Los jefes de cien hicieron todo lo que el sacerdote Joiada había ordenado. Cada uno llevó a sus hombres, tanto a los que entraban de servicio el sábado como a los que salían ese día, y se presentaron ante el sacerdote Joiada.
es.R: Los jefes hicieron todo lo que el sacerdote Joiada les dijo. Cada uno llevó a sus hombres, tanto a los que empezaban su servicio el sábado como a los que lo terminaban. Todos se presentaron ante el sacerdote Joiada.

fr.L: Et les chefs de centaines firent selon tout ce qu’avait ordonné Yehoyada le prêtre, et ils prirent chacun ses hommes, ceux qui entraient le jour du sabbat avec ceux qui sortaient le jour du sabbat, et ils vinrent auprès de Yehoyada le prêtre.
fr.B: Les chefs de centaines firent tout ce que Yehoyada le prêtre avait ordonné. Chacun prit ses hommes, ceux qui prenaient leur service le jour du sabbat comme ceux qui le quittaient ce jour-là, et ils se rendirent auprès de Yehoyada le prêtre.
fr.R: Les chefs ont fait exactement ce que Yehoyada le prêtre leur avait dit. Chacun a amené ses hommes, ceux qui commençaient leur service le jour du sabbat et ceux qui le finissaient. Ils sont tous venus auprès de Yehoyada le prêtre.

sw.L: Wakuu wa mamia wakafanya sawasawa na yote aliyoamuru Yehoyada kuhani, kila mmoja akawachukua watu wake, wale walioingia siku ya Sabato pamoja na wale waliotoka siku ya Sabato, wakaja kwa Yehoyada kuhani.
sw.B: Wakuu wa mamia walifanya kila kitu ambacho Yehoyada kuhani aliamuru. Kila mmoja akaleta watu wake, wale walioingia zamu siku ya Sabato na wale waliotoka zamu siku hiyo, wakaja kwa Yehoyada kuhani.
sw.R: Makamanda wakafanya kama Yehoyada kuhani alivyowaambia. Kila mmoja akaleta watu wake, wale waliokuwa wakianza zamu siku ya Sabato na wale waliokuwa wakiimaliza. Wote wakaja kwa Yehoyada kuhani.

vi.L: Các chỉ huy trăm người làm theo mọi điều thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa đã truyền. Mỗi người đem người của mình, những người vào phiên ngày Sa-bát cùng với những người ra phiên ngày Sa-bát, đến với thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa.
vi.B: Các chỉ huy trăm người làm đúng mọi điều thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa đã truyền. Mỗi người dẫn quân của mình, cả những người vào phiên lẫn những người mãn phiên ngày Sa-bát, đến gặp thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa.
vi.R: Các chỉ huy làm đúng như thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa đã bảo. Mỗi người dẫn quân của mình đến, cả những người bắt đầu phiên trực ngày Sa-bát lẫn những người vừa hết phiên. Tất cả đều đến gặp thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa.

ko.L: 그리고 백부장들이 제사장 여호야다가 명령한 모든 것대로 행했다. 그리고 각자 자기 부하들, 곧 안식일에 들어오는 자들과 안식일에 나가는 자들을 데리고 제사장 여호야다에게 왔다.
ko.B: 백부장들은 제사장 여호야다가 명령한 대로 다 했다. 그들은 각자 안식일에 근무하러 들어오는 부하들과 근무를 마치고 나가는 부하들을 데리고 제사장 여호야다에게 왔다.
ko.R: 지휘관들은 제사장 여호야다가 말한 그대로 했다. 그들은 저마다 안식일에 근무를 시작하는 부하들과 근무를 마치는 부하들을 모두 데리고 제사장 여호야다에게 왔다.

pt.L: E os chefes de centenas fizeram conforme tudo o que Joiada, o sacerdote, tinha ordenado, e cada um tomou os seus homens, os que entravam no sábado com os que saíam no sábado, e vieram a Joiada, o sacerdote.
pt.B: Os comandantes de centenas fizeram tudo o que o sacerdote Joiada tinha ordenado. Cada um trouxe os seus homens, tanto os que entravam de serviço no sábado como os que deixavam o serviço naquele dia, e eles foram ao sacerdote Joiada.
pt.R: Os comandantes fizeram exatamente o que o sacerdote Joiada lhes disse. Cada um levou os seus homens, tanto os que estavam começando o serviço no sábado como os que estavam terminando. Todos eles foram até o sacerdote Joiada.

decisions.choice: both shifts together
decisions.reason: The men coming on duty and those going off duty were both brought to the temple, as Jehoiada had ordered (verses 5-7), so the force was twice its usual size.

decisions.choice: did according to all that he had commanded: full obedience
decisions.reason: The narrator stresses that the plan was carried out exactly as given.

decisions.choice: The commanders
decisions.reason: Readable shortens "commanders of hundreds", already explained at verse 4.

source.text: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן הַכֹּהֵ֜ן לְשָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּא֗וֹת אֶֽת־הַחֲנִית֙ וְאֶת־הַשְּׁלָטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And gave the priest to [the] commanders of the hundreds the spear and the shields which [were] to the king David, which [were] in [the] house of Yahweh.

en.L: And the priest gave to the commanders of hundreds the spear and the shields that [had belonged] to King David, which [were] in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: The priest gave the commanders of hundreds the spears and shields that had belonged to King David and were kept in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The priest handed out to the commanders the spears and shields that had belonged to King David. They were kept in the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y el sacerdote dio a los jefes de cien la lanza y los escudos que [habían sido] del rey David, que [estaban] en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: El sacerdote les entregó a los jefes de cien las lanzas y los escudos que habían sido del rey David y que se guardaban en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: El sacerdote les repartió a los jefes las lanzas y los escudos que habían sido del rey David. Se guardaban en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et le prêtre donna aux chefs de centaines la lance et les boucliers qui [avaient appartenu] au roi David, et qui [étaient] dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Le prêtre remit aux chefs de centaines les lances et les boucliers qui avaient appartenu au roi David et qu’on gardait dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Le prêtre a distribué aux chefs les lances et les boucliers qui avaient appartenu au roi David. Ils étaient gardés dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Kuhani akawapa wakuu wa mamia mkuki na ngao [zilizokuwa] za mfalme Daudi, zilizokuwa katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Kuhani akawapa wakuu wa mamia mikuki na ngao zilizokuwa mali ya mfalme Daudi, zilizowekwa katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kuhani akawagawia makamanda mikuki na ngao zilizokuwa mali ya mfalme Daudi. Zilikuwa zimewekwa katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Thầy tế lễ trao cho các chỉ huy trăm người giáo và khiên của vua Đa-vít, là những thứ ở trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Thầy tế lễ trao cho các chỉ huy trăm người những cây giáo và những cái khiên trước kia của vua Đa-vít, được cất giữ trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Thầy tế lễ phát cho các chỉ huy những cây giáo và những cái khiên trước kia của vua Đa-vít. Những vũ khí này được cất giữ trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장이 백부장들에게 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 있던, 다윗 왕의 [것이었던] 창과 방패들을 주었다.
ko.B: 제사장은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 보관되어 있던 다윗 왕의 창과 방패들을 백부장들에게 주었다.
ko.R: 제사장은 다윗 왕의 것이었던 창과 방패들을 지휘관들에게 나누어 주었다. 그것들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 보관되어 있었다.

pt.L: E o sacerdote deu aos chefes de centenas a lança e os escudos que [tinham sido] do rei Davi, que [estavam] na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: O sacerdote entregou aos comandantes de centenas as lanças e os escudos que tinham pertencido ao rei Davi e que estavam guardados na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: O sacerdote entregou aos comandantes as lanças e os escudos que tinham sido do rei Davi. Eles estavam guardados no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

decisions.choice: the spear: spears, a collective
decisions.reason: The word is singular but stands for the spears as a group; 2 Chronicles 23:9 has the plural.

decisions.choice: the shields: probably a kind of shield
decisions.reason: The word is rare. It is used of the gold pieces David took from Hadadezer's officers (2 Samuel 8:7), and was most likely a type of shield, though some take it as quivers or as armor in general.

decisions.choice: David's weapons in the temple: trophies kept at the house of Yahweh
decisions.reason: Weapons won in battle were kept in a sanctuary as a sign of victory (1 Samuel 21:10; 2 Samuel 8:7, 11). Arming the guard with David's own weapons tied the new king to David's line.

decisions.choice: spears
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the collective singular as a plural (m1).

source.text: וַיַּעַמְד֨וּ הָרָצִ֜ים אִ֣ישׁ׀וְכֵלָ֣יו בְּיָד֗וֹ מִכֶּ֨תֶף הַבַּ֤יִת הַיְמָנִית֙ עַד־כֶּ֤תֶף הַבַּ֨יִת֙ הַשְּׂמָאלִ֔ית לַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ וְלַבָּ֑יִת עַל־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ סָבִֽיב׃

records.literal_gloss: And stood the runners, each man and his weapons in his hand, from [the] side of the house the right to [the] side of the house the left, by the altar and by the house, by the king all around.

en.L: And the runners stood, each man with his weapons in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, by the altar and by the house, around the king on every side.
en.B: The guards took their places, each man with his weapons in hand, from the south side of the temple to the north side, beside the altar and the temple, surrounding the king.
en.R: The guards stood in their places, holding their weapons. They formed a line from the south side of the temple to the north side, near the altar and the temple building, to surround and protect the king.

es.L: Y se apostó la guardia, cada uno con sus armas en la mano, desde el lado derecho de la casa hasta el lado izquierdo de la casa, junto al altar y junto a la casa, alrededor del rey.
es.B: Los guardias se colocaron, cada uno con sus armas en la mano, desde el lado sur del templo hasta el lado norte, junto al altar y al templo, rodeando al rey.
es.R: Los guardias se pusieron en sus puestos con las armas en la mano. Formaron una fila desde el lado sur del templo hasta el lado norte, cerca del altar y del edificio del templo, para rodear y proteger al rey.

fr.L: Et les coureurs se tinrent, chacun ses armes à la main, depuis le côté droit de la maison jusqu’au côté gauche de la maison, près de l’autel et près de la maison, autour du roi.
fr.B: Les gardes prirent position, chacun les armes à la main, du côté sud du temple jusqu’au côté nord, près de l’autel et du temple, tout autour du roi.
fr.R: Les gardes se sont mis à leur place, en tenant leurs armes. Ils ont formé une ligne du côté sud du temple jusqu’au côté nord, près de l’autel et du bâtiment du temple, pour entourer et protéger le roi.

sw.L: Wakimbiaji wakasimama, kila mtu na silaha zake mkononi mwake, kutoka upande wa kulia wa nyumba mpaka upande wa kushoto wa nyumba, karibu na madhabahu na karibu na nyumba, kumzunguka mfalme pande zote.
sw.B: Walinzi wakashika nafasi zao, kila mtu akiwa na silaha zake mkononi, kutoka upande wa kusini wa hekalu mpaka upande wa kaskazini, kando ya madhabahu na hekalu, wakimzunguka mfalme.
sw.R: Walinzi wakasimama mahali pao, wakiwa wameshika silaha zao. Wakasimama mstari kutoka upande wa kusini wa hekalu mpaka upande wa kaskazini, karibu na madhabahu na jengo la hekalu, ili kumzunguka mfalme na kumlinda.

vi.L: Các vệ binh đứng, mỗi người cầm vũ khí trong tay, từ phía bên phải của nhà đến phía bên trái của nhà, cạnh bàn thờ và cạnh nhà, vây quanh vua tứ phía.
vi.B: Các vệ binh vào vị trí, mỗi người cầm vũ khí trong tay, từ phía nam đền thờ đến phía bắc, cạnh bàn thờ và đền thờ, vây quanh vua.
vi.R: Các vệ binh đứng vào vị trí, tay cầm vũ khí. Họ dàn thành hàng từ phía nam đến phía bắc đền thờ, gần bàn thờ và tòa nhà đền thờ, để vây quanh bảo vệ vua.

ko.L: 그리고 달리는 자들이 각자 손에 무기를 들고 그 집의 오른쪽에서부터 그 집의 왼쪽까지, 제단과 그 집 곁에, 왕을 사방으로 둘러싸고 섰다.
ko.B: 호위병들은 각자 손에 무기를 들고 성전 남쪽에서부터 북쪽까지 제단과 성전 곁에 늘어서서 왕을 둘러쌌다.
ko.R: 호위병들은 무기를 들고 자기 자리에 섰다. 그들은 성전 남쪽에서부터 북쪽까지 제단과 성전 건물 가까이에 줄을 지어 서서 왕을 둘러싸고 지켰다.

pt.L: E os corredores ficaram de pé, cada homem com as suas armas na mão, desde o lado direito da casa até o lado esquerdo da casa, junto ao altar e junto à casa, ao redor do rei.
pt.B: Os guardas tomaram os seus lugares, cada um com as armas na mão, desde o lado sul do templo até o lado norte, junto ao altar e ao templo, em volta do rei.
pt.R: Os guardas ficaram nos seus lugares, segurando as suas armas. Eles formaram uma linha do lado sul do templo até o lado norte, perto do altar e do prédio do templo, para cercar e proteger o rei.

decisions.choice: right side, left side: south side, north side
decisions.reason: Directions were named facing east, the way the temple faced, so "right" is south and "left" is north. The guards stretched across the whole front of the temple.

decisions.choice: the altar and the house: the open court in front of the temple
decisions.reason: The altar for burnt offerings stood in the court before the temple building (1 Kings 8:64). The guards filled the space between the altar and the building, where the king would be shown.

decisions.choice: around the king: in position to guard him
decisions.reason: The guard took up its places around the spot where the king would stand; he is brought out in the next verse.

decisions.choice: south side; north side
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the compass directions that "right" and "left" mean here (m1).

decisions.choice: to surround and protect the king
decisions.reason: Readable adds "protect" to make the guard's purpose clear (verse 8).

decisions.choice: "남쪽", "북쪽" at Balanced and Readable for the right and left sides; Literal keeps "오른쪽", "왼쪽"
decisions.reason: Facing east, as the temple did, the right side is the south; the meaning decision says so (m1).

source.text: וַיּוֹצִ֣א אֶת־בֶּן־הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וַיִּתֵּ֤ן עָלָיו֙ אֶת־הַנֵּ֨זֶר֙ וְאֶת־הָ֣עֵד֔וּת וַיַּמְלִ֥כוּ אֹת֖וֹ וַיִּמְשָׁחֻ֑הוּ וַיַּכּוּ־כָ֔ף וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ יְחִ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he brought out the son of the king and put on him the crown and the testimony, and they made king him and anointed him, and struck a palm and said, may live the king.

en.L: And he brought out the son of the king and put on him the crown and the testimony; and they made him king and anointed him, and they clapped [their] hands and said, "May the king live!"
en.B: Then Jehoiada brought out the king's son and put on him the crown and the testimony. They made him king and anointed him. Then they clapped their hands and shouted, "Long live the king!"
en.R: Then Jehoiada brought out the king's son. He put the crown on him and the testimony. They made him king and poured olive oil on his head. Everyone clapped and shouted, "Long live the king!"

es.L: Y sacó al hijo del rey y puso sobre él la corona y el testimonio; y lo hicieron rey y lo ungieron, y batieron palmas y dijeron: «¡Viva el rey!».
es.B: Entonces Joiada sacó al hijo del rey y le puso la corona y el testimonio. Lo proclamaron rey y lo ungieron. Luego aplaudieron y gritaron: «¡Viva el rey!».
es.R: Entonces Joiada sacó al hijo del rey. Le puso la corona y le entregó el testimonio. Lo hicieron rey y le derramaron aceite de oliva sobre la cabeza. Todos aplaudieron y gritaron: «¡Viva el rey!».

fr.L: Et il fit sortir le fils du roi et mit sur lui le diadème et le témoignage ; et ils le firent roi et l’oignirent, et ils battirent des mains et dirent : « Que vive le roi ! »
fr.B: Puis Yehoyada fit sortir le fils du roi et lui remit le diadème et le témoignage. On le proclama roi et on l’oignit. Puis on battit des mains en criant : « Vive le roi ! »
fr.R: Ensuite Yehoyada a fait sortir le fils du roi. Il lui a mis le diadème sur la tête et lui a remis le témoignage. On l’a fait roi et on lui a versé de l’huile d’olive sur la tête. Tout le monde a applaudi et a crié : « Vive le roi ! »

sw.L: Akamtoa mwana wa mfalme, akamvika taji na Ushuhuda; wakamfanya mfalme, wakampaka mafuta, wakapiga makofi, wakasema, "Mfalme na aishi!"
sw.B: Kisha Yehoyada akamtoa mwana wa mfalme, akamvika taji na kumpa Ushuhuda. Wakamfanya mfalme, wakampaka mafuta. Kisha wakapiga makofi, wakapaza sauti, "Mfalme aishi milele!"
sw.R: Kisha Yehoyada akamtoa mwana wa mfalme. Akamvika taji na kumpa Ushuhuda. Wakamfanya mfalme, wakamimina mafuta ya zeituni juu ya kichwa chake. Watu wote wakapiga makofi, wakapaza sauti, "Mfalme aishi milele!"

vi.L: Ông đưa con trai vua ra, đội vương miện cho cậu và trao bản chứng ước; họ lập cậu làm vua và xức dầu cho cậu, rồi họ vỗ tay và nói: "Vua vạn tuế!"
vi.B: Rồi Giê-hô-gia-đa đưa hoàng tử ra, đội vương miện cho cậu và trao bản chứng ước. Họ lập cậu làm vua và xức dầu cho cậu. Rồi họ vỗ tay và hô: "Vua vạn tuế!"
vi.R: Rồi Giê-hô-gia-đa đưa hoàng tử ra. Ông đội vương miện cho cậu và trao cho cậu bản chứng ước. Họ lập cậu làm vua và đổ dầu ô-liu trên đầu cậu. Mọi người vỗ tay và hô: "Vua vạn tuế!"

ko.L: 그리고 그가 왕의 아들을 데리고 나와서 그에게 왕관을 씌우고 증거를 [주었다]. 그리고 그들이 그를 왕으로 세우고 그에게 기름을 부었다. 그리고 그들이 손뼉을 치며 말했다. "왕이 사시기를!"
ko.B: 여호야다가 왕자를 데리고 나와서 그에게 왕관을 씌우고 증거의 말씀을 주었다. 그들은 그를 왕으로 세우고 그에게 기름을 부었다. 그리고 손뼉을 치며 외쳤다. "왕 만세!"
ko.R: 여호야다가 왕자를 데리고 나왔다. 그는 왕자에게 왕관을 씌우고 하나님의 언약의 말씀을 적은 증거를 주었다. 사람들은 그를 왕으로 세우고 그의 머리에 올리브기름을 부었다. 모두 손뼉을 치며 외쳤다. "왕 만세!"

pt.L: E ele trouxe para fora o filho do rei e pôs sobre ele a coroa e o Testemunho; e o fizeram rei e o ungiram, e bateram palmas e disseram: "Viva o rei!"
pt.B: Então Joiada trouxe para fora o filho do rei e pôs sobre ele a coroa e o Testemunho. Eles o proclamaram rei e o ungiram. Depois bateram palmas e gritaram: "Viva o rei!"
pt.R: Então Joiada trouxe para fora o filho do rei. Ele pôs no menino a coroa e o Testemunho. Eles o fizeram rei e derramaram azeite na cabeça dele. Todos bateram palmas e gritaram: "Viva o rei!"

decisions.choice: the testimony: probably a written copy of Yahweh's covenant law
decisions.reason: The word is used for the covenant law, especially the tablets kept in the ark (Exodus 25:16, 21). The king was to have his own copy of the law (Deuteronomy 17:18-19), and this may be what was given to Joash at his crowning, perhaps placed on him or held over him. Because Saul's crown is paired with an armband in 2 Samuel 1:10, and the two Hebrew words look alike, some think this was a royal ornament rather than a document.

decisions.choice: the crown: the sign of a consecrated ruler
decisions.reason: The word comes from a root meaning "set apart". It names the royal crown (2 Samuel 1:10) and also the high priest's holy diadem (Exodus 29:6).

decisions.choice: may the king live: the acclamation of a new king
decisions.reason: This is the cry with which the people welcomed a new king, as with Saul and Solomon (1 Samuel 10:24; 1 Kings 1:25, 39).

decisions.choice: anointed him and clapped their hands: the public crowning
decisions.reason: Anointing with oil set a man apart as king (1 Kings 1:39). Clapping was a shout of joy and loyalty for a king (Psalm 47:2).

decisions.choice: Long live the king!
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 1:25, Balanced and Readable use the familiar English acclamation; Literal keeps the Hebrew form.

decisions.choice: the testimony
decisions.reason: Every level keeps "testimony", the singular used for the covenant tablets, rather than "decrees" or "instructions" used for the plural, because the sense here is uncertain (m1).

decisions.choice: Jehoiada; poured olive oil on his head
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Jehoiada as the one who brought the boy out; Readable explains what anointing is, as in 1 Kings 1:34.

decisions.choice: el testimonio (every level)
decisions.reason: Every level keeps "el testimonio", the Pentateuch note's word for the covenant law (m1), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "le témoignage"
decisions.reason: As the English keeps "the testimony" at every level; the meaning decision explains that it is probably a written copy of Yahweh’s covenant law.

decisions.choice: "Ushuhuda"
decisions.reason: The testimony is the word the Swahili Pentateuch uses for the covenant tablets ("Ushuhuda"); it is kept at every level, as English keeps "testimony".

decisions.choice: "bản chứng ước"
decisions.reason: The testimony is probably a written copy of Yahweh's covenant law (m1); "chứng ước" keeps the word's root in witness and covenant.

decisions.choice: "Vua vạn tuế!"
decisions.reason: The acclamation of a new king (m3), in the 1 Samuel drafts' wording.

decisions.choice: "증거" (L), "증거의 말씀" (B), "하나님의 언약의 말씀을 적은 증거" (R) for "the testimony"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision takes it as a written copy of the LORD's covenant law (m1); Korean keeps the word "증거" at every level, as the English keeps "testimony", and Readable says what it was.

decisions.choice: "왕 만세!" at Balanced and Readable; Literal keeps "왕이 사시기를!"
decisions.reason: The usual Korean acclamation; the 2 Samuel drafts use it for Hushai's cry.

decisions.choice: Viva o rei! (every level)
decisions.reason: The acclamation of a new king (m3) is "Viva o rei!" at every level, Literal included, as 1 Samuel 10:24 and 1 Kings 1:25, 34 and 39 set it in Portuguese: "Viva" is already the wish "may he live".

decisions.choice: a coroa; o Testemunho; ungiram (L, B), derramaram azeite na cabeça dele (R)
decisions.reason: "O Testemunho" is the Old Testament terms' word for the covenant law kept in the ark (m1), with its capital, kept at every level as the English keeps "testimony", since what Joash received is not certain. Readable says what anointing is in the words of 1 Kings 1:34 at Readable.

source.text: וַתִּשְׁמַ֣ע עֲתַלְיָ֔ה אֶת־ק֥וֹל הָֽרָצִ֖ין הָעָ֑ם וַתָּבֹ֥א אֶל־הָעָ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And heard Athaliah the sound of the runners, the people, and came to the people [to the] house of Yahweh.

en.L: And Athaliah heard the sound of the runners [and] the people, and she came to the people [in] the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: When Athaliah heard the noise of the guards and the people, she went to the people at the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Athaliah heard the noise the guards and the people were making. So she went to the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, where the people were.

es.L: Y oyó Atalía el ruido de la guardia [y] del pueblo, y vino al pueblo [en] la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Cuando Atalía oyó el ruido de los guardias y del pueblo, fue adonde estaba el pueblo, en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Atalía oyó el ruido que hacían los guardias y el pueblo. Entonces fue al templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, donde estaba el pueblo.

fr.L: Et Athalie entendit le bruit des coureurs [et] du peuple, et elle vint vers le peuple [dans] la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Quand Athalie entendit le bruit des gardes et du peuple, elle se rendit auprès du peuple, à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Athalie a entendu le bruit que faisaient les gardes et le peuple. Alors elle est allée au temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, où se trouvait le peuple.

sw.L: Athalia aliposikia sauti ya wakimbiaji [na] watu, akaja kwa watu [katika] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Athalia aliposikia kelele za walinzi na za watu, alikwenda kwa watu katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Athalia alisikia kelele walizokuwa wakipiga walinzi na watu. Basi akaenda katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, walipokuwa watu.

vi.L: A-tha-li nghe tiếng các vệ binh [và] dân chúng, bèn đến với dân chúng [ở] nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Khi A-tha-li nghe tiếng ồn ào của các vệ binh và dân chúng, bà đến chỗ dân chúng ở nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: A-tha-li nghe tiếng ồn ào của các vệ binh và dân chúng. Vậy bà đến đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nơi dân chúng đang tụ họp.

ko.L: 그리고 아달랴가 달리는 자들과 백성의 소리를 듣고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 있는 백성에게로 왔다.
ko.B: 아달랴는 호위병들과 백성이 떠드는 소리를 듣고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 모인 백성에게로 갔다.
ko.R: 아달랴는 호위병들과 백성이 떠드는 소리를 들었다. 그래서 백성이 모여 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전으로 갔다.

pt.L: E Atalia ouviu o som dos corredores [e] do povo, e foi até o povo [na] casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Quando Atalia ouviu o barulho dos guardas e do povo, foi até o povo na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Atalia ouviu o barulho que os guardas e o povo estavam fazendo. Então foi até o templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, onde o povo estava.

decisions.choice: the runners, the people: the guards and the people
decisions.reason: The two words stand side by side with no "and", and "runners" has an unusual ending. The sense is the noise of the guards together with the crowd. 2 Chronicles 23:12 has "the people running and praising the king".

decisions.choice: she came to the people: Athaliah goes into the temple court
decisions.reason: She came alone into the place where the guards had been set (verses 7-11), into the trap that had been laid.

decisions.choice: and
decisions.reason: English needs "and" between the two nouns (m1); Literal brackets it.

source.text: וַתֵּ֡רֶא וְהִנֵּ֣ה הַמֶּלֶךְ֩ עֹמֵ֨ד עַֽל־הָעַמּ֜וּד כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֗ט וְהַשָּׂרִ֤ים וְהַחֲצֹֽצְרוֹת֙ אֶל־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְכָל־עַ֤ם הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ שָׂמֵ֔חַ וְתֹקֵ֖עַ בַּחֲצֹֽצְר֑וֹת וַתִּקְרַ֤ע עֲתַלְיָה֙ אֶת־בְּגָדֶ֔יהָ וַתִּקְרָ֖א קֶ֥שֶׁר קָֽשֶׁר׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And she looked, and look, the king [was] standing by the pillar according to the custom, and the commanders and the trumpets [were] by the king, and all [the] people of the land [were] rejoicing and blowing on trumpets; and tore Athaliah her clothes and called out, conspiracy, conspiracy.

en.L: And she looked, and look, the king [was] standing by the pillar according to the custom, and the commanders and the trumpets [were] beside the king, and all the people of the land [were] rejoicing and blowing on trumpets; and Athaliah tore her clothes and called out, "Treason! Treason!"
en.B: She looked, and there was the king, standing by the pillar as the custom was, with the commanders and the trumpeters beside him. All the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets. Athaliah tore her clothes and cried out, "Treason! Treason!"
en.R: She looked and saw the new king standing by the pillar, where kings stood by custom. The commanders and the trumpet players were next to him. All the people of the land were celebrating and blowing trumpets. Athaliah tore her clothes and screamed, "Treason! Treason!"

es.L: Y miró, y he aquí que el rey [estaba] de pie junto a la columna, según la costumbre, y los jefes y las trompetas [estaban] junto al rey, y todo el pueblo de la tierra [estaba] alegre y tocaba las trompetas. Y Atalía rasgó sus vestidos y gritó: «¡Traición! ¡Traición!».
es.B: Miró, y allí estaba el rey, de pie junto a la columna, como era costumbre, con los jefes y los trompeteros a su lado. Todo el pueblo de la tierra estaba alegre y tocaba las trompetas. Atalía se rasgó las vestiduras y gritó: «¡Traición! ¡Traición!».
es.R: Miró y vio al nuevo rey de pie junto a la columna, donde los reyes se ponían por costumbre. Los jefes y los que tocaban la trompeta estaban a su lado. Todo el pueblo de la tierra celebraba y tocaba las trompetas. Atalía se rasgó la ropa y gritó: «¡Traición! ¡Traición!».

fr.L: Et elle regarda, et voici, le roi se tenait près de la colonne, selon la coutume, et les chefs et les trompettes [étaient] près du roi, et tout le peuple du pays se réjouissait et sonnait des trompettes ; et Athalie déchira ses vêtements et cria : « Conspiration ! Conspiration ! »
fr.B: Elle regarda : le roi se tenait près de la colonne, selon la coutume, avec les chefs et les trompettes à ses côtés. Tout le peuple du pays était dans la joie et sonnait des trompettes. Athalie déchira ses vêtements et cria : « Trahison ! Trahison ! »
fr.R: Elle a regardé et elle a vu le nouveau roi debout près de la colonne, là où les rois se tenaient d’habitude. Les chefs et les joueurs de trompette étaient à côté de lui. Tout le peuple du pays faisait la fête et sonnait des trompettes. Athalie a déchiré ses vêtements et elle a hurlé : « Trahison ! Trahison ! »

sw.L: Akatazama, na tazama, mfalme [alikuwa] amesimama karibu na nguzo kama ilivyokuwa desturi, na wakuu na tarumbeta [walikuwa] karibu na mfalme, na watu wote wa nchi [walikuwa] wakishangilia na kupiga tarumbeta. Athalia akararua mavazi yake, akalia, "Uhaini! Uhaini!"
sw.B: Akatazama, na pale alikuwa mfalme amesimama karibu na nguzo kama ilivyokuwa desturi, pamoja na wakuu na wapiga tarumbeta kando yake. Watu wote wa nchi walikuwa wakishangilia na kupiga tarumbeta. Athalia akararua mavazi yake, akalia, "Uhaini! Uhaini!"
sw.R: Akatazama, akamwona mfalme mpya amesimama karibu na nguzo, mahali ambapo wafalme walisimama kwa desturi. Makamanda na wapiga tarumbeta walikuwa karibu naye. Watu wote wa nchi walikuwa wakisherehekea na kupiga tarumbeta. Athalia akararua mavazi yake, akapiga kelele, "Uhaini! Uhaini!"

vi.L: Bà nhìn, và kìa, vua đang đứng cạnh cây trụ theo thông lệ, các chỉ huy và kèn ở bên cạnh vua, và toàn dân trong xứ đang vui mừng và thổi kèn. A-tha-li xé áo mình và kêu lên: "Phản loạn! Phản loạn!"
vi.B: Bà nhìn thì thấy vua đang đứng cạnh cây trụ theo thông lệ, các chỉ huy và những người thổi kèn ở bên cạnh vua. Toàn dân trong xứ đang vui mừng và thổi kèn. A-tha-li xé áo mình và kêu lên: "Phản loạn! Phản loạn!"
vi.R: Bà nhìn và thấy vị vua mới đang đứng cạnh cây trụ, là chỗ các vua vẫn đứng theo thông lệ. Các chỉ huy và những người thổi kèn đứng bên cạnh vua. Toàn dân trong xứ đang vui mừng và thổi kèn. A-tha-li xé áo mình và la lên: "Phản loạn! Phản loạn!"

ko.L: 그리고 그가 보니, 보라, 왕이 관례대로 기둥 곁에 서 있고, 지휘관들과 나팔들이 왕 곁에 [있고], 그 땅의 온 백성이 기뻐하며 나팔을 불고 있었다. 그러자 아달랴가 자기 옷을 찢으며 외쳤다. "반역이다! 반역이다!"
ko.B: 그가 보니, 왕이 관례대로 기둥 곁에 서 있고, 지휘관들과 나팔수들이 왕 곁에 있었다. 그 땅의 온 백성은 기뻐하며 나팔을 불고 있었다. 아달랴는 자기 옷을 찢으며 외쳤다. "반역이다! 반역이다!"
ko.R: 아달랴가 보니, 새 왕이 기둥 곁에 서 있었다. 그곳은 왕들이 관례대로 서는 자리였다. 지휘관들과 나팔 부는 사람들이 왕 곁에 있었다. 그 땅의 온 백성은 기뻐하며 나팔을 불고 있었다. 아달랴는 자기 옷을 찢으며 소리를 질렀다. "반역이다! 반역이다!"

pt.L: E ela olhou, e eis que o rei [estava] de pé junto à coluna, conforme o costume, e os chefes e as trombetas [estavam] junto ao rei, e todo o povo da terra [estava] se alegrando e tocando trombetas; e Atalia rasgou as suas roupas e gritou: "Traição! Traição!"
pt.B: Ela olhou, e lá estava o rei, de pé junto à coluna, como era o costume, com os comandantes e os trompetistas ao seu lado. Todo o povo da terra estava se alegrando e tocando trombetas. Atalia rasgou as suas roupas e gritou: "Traição! Traição!"
pt.R: Ela olhou e viu o novo rei de pé junto à coluna, onde os reis ficavam por costume. Os comandantes e os tocadores de trombeta estavam ao lado dele. Todo o povo da terra estava festejando e tocando trombetas. Atalia rasgou as suas roupas e gritou: "Traição! Traição!"

decisions.choice: by the pillar according to the custom: the king's place in the temple court
decisions.reason: The king had a set place by a pillar at the temple, where he stood on public occasions (23:3). It may have been one of the two bronze pillars at the entrance (1 Kings 7:21) or a raised platform; the text does not say.

decisions.choice: the people of the land: the citizens of Judah
decisions.reason: The phrase here means the free people of Judah as a body, as distinct from the court and the palace. They support Joash and take part in the covenant (verses 17-20).

decisions.choice: treason: a conspiracy against the ruler
decisions.reason: The word means a plot or conspiracy, the same word used of Jehu's plot against Joram (9:14). Repeated, it is a cry of alarm. Athaliah calls the crowning of David's heir a plot against her.

decisions.choice: tore her clothes: a sign of distress
decisions.reason: Tearing one's clothes showed grief, horror or alarm (2 Kings 5:7; 6:30).

decisions.choice: the commanders and the trumpets: the officers and the trumpeters
decisions.reason: "The trumpets" stands for those who blew them, beside the king.

decisions.choice: the trumpeters (Balanced); the trumpet players (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who stood by the king (m5); Literal keeps "trumpets".

decisions.choice: Treason! Treason!
decisions.reason: "Treason" gives the sense of a plot against the throne in a short cry; "Conspiracy!" would be the more literal word, but is not something one shouts.

decisions.choice: "그 땅의 온 백성" for "all the people of the land"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the phrase as the citizens of Judah (m2); the Korean keeps the Hebrew phrase at every level, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Traição! Traição! (every level)
decisions.reason: The word for a plot against the ruler (m3) is the noun of the verb "conspirar" used for Jehu at 9:14, but "Conspiração!" is not something one shouts; "Traição!" is the Portuguese cry of alarm at a plot against the throne, as the English "Treason!" is. Joram's cry at 9:23 is also "Traição", for a different Hebrew word with the same sense.

decisions.choice: o povo da terra
decisions.reason: "O povo da terra" keeps the Hebrew phrase for the free citizens of Judah (m2) at every level, as the English does, through verse 20.

source.text: וַיְצַו֩ יְהוֹיָדָ֨ע הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־שָׂרֵ֥י הַמֵּא֣וֹת׀פְּקֻדֵ֣י הַחַ֗יִל וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם֙ הוֹצִ֤יאוּ אֹתָהּ֙ אֶל־מִבֵּ֣ית לַשְּׂדֵרֹ֔ת וְהַבָּ֥א אַחֲרֶ֖יהָ הָמֵ֣ת בֶּחָ֑רֶב כִּ֚י אָמַ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אַל־תּוּמַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
